intro.title: Read Your Friend
intro.desc: Go beyond casual social interactions. Evaluate your friend's social energy, presence, and boundaries. This quiz is anonymous; your individual answers will never be shared directly.
intro.question: How are they perceived in the eyes of others?
intro.evaluatedDesc: You have successfully shared your perspective for this person. Thank you for your contribution.
intro.cappedDesc: {name}'s profile has reached its maximum participant limit.
intro.lockedMaskDesc: At least 3 friends must complete the quiz to unlock this profile.
intro.lockedCompleteTestTitle: Complete Quiz to View Outside Perception
intro.lockedCompleteTestDesc: To view this person's outside perception results, you must first complete your evaluation of them.

quiz.privacyNote: No one is exposed. Individual answers are never shown.
quiz.submittingDesc: Calculating perception metrics and matching reading style...

result.completedDesc: You have reflected your friend through your eyes. The analytical engine calculated your reading style based on your signals.
result.accuracyDesc: The matching rate between how they see themselves and how you read them.
result.startOwnDesc: Start your own quiz to compare how you see yourself against how friends read you.
result.goToDashboardDesc: You just read a friend. Now go back to your dashboard and discover how others are reading you in return.

share.whatsAppText: A slice from the Subconscious Archive: My aura through the eyes of my circle took shape as '{cardName}'. What is my reflection in your world? See behind the mirror: {url}
share.storyReadyDesc: Your story image has been downloaded. To add a clickable link:
share.step1: 1. Open Instagram and create a new Story
share.step2: 2. Add the downloaded image as background
share.storyQuote: "How am I reflected in your world?"
